body: This 2025 Sprinter AWD 170 build in our El Capitan Tier is built for road trips, camping, and comfortable travel with a clean custom interior and strong adventure setup. It features 800Ah lithium power, solar, roof A/C, diesel heat, a 33 gallon water system, full kitchen, custom dinette seating, exterior storage, upgraded suspension, and a custom indoor bathroom with its own vanity, sink, mirror, and shower setup.
